evidence: The old default at google.py:56 is ['profile'] and the issue asks to update that line to the new scope names. The gold patch maps it to ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile']; the agent (step 28) also added userinfo.email, so test_blueprint_factory's equality check fails. The agent's verify_fix.py and comprehensive_test.py assert the two-URL list it chose itself.

The agent's patch adds only debug scripts; _list_view.py still calls items.remove() on every ListItem. At step 49 it reproduced the bug with PYTHONPATH=src, then issued task_tracker view about 25 times and the run ended with AgentStuckInLoopError. Without PYTHONPATH its test_bug_real.py loads a newer textual from site-packages that already removes only the chosen items (steps 32-44), so its check reports no bug without any fix.

The gold patch switches both the mapping palette (ImagePalette(palette_mode, mapping_palette * bands) and putpalette(palette_mode + ';L')) and the output palette to the source palette mode. The agent changed only the source read and the output putpalette, leaving the 'RGB;L' mapping step. Its own simple_test_fix.py at step 89 printed both pixels as (255, 0, 0, 0) after remap, which it called 'odd' and ignored; the upstream identity test asserts assert_image_equal(im, im_remapped).

The gold patch changes expand_factors in src/tox/config/loader/ini/factor.py so a colon only starts a factor filter when followed by a space; the test adds a 'no:space' line that must survive. The agent's only source edit was to StrConvert.to_list (\r handling, variable rename), whose output it had already shown to be correct before the change (step 89: 'No transformation occurred'). Its test_fix_verification.py and test_port_regression.py check list splitting, not the INI factor filtering that drops the host port.

The gold patch resets gates, customgates, registers, qubit_count and circuit at the start of parse(); the test asserts c2.qubits == 1. The agent added only self.gates = [], and its own run at step 20 printed 'Circuit(2 qubits, 0 bits, 1 gates) [HAD(1)]' for c2, against the issue's expected '1 qubits ... [HAD(0)]'. Its final_verification.py checks only gate counts and that c1 is unchanged, never the qubit count.

The issue says the return type is missing from the docstring and 'the API change needs a prominent mention in the HISTORY.rst', which reads as keeping the tuple. The gold patch instead reverts the method to return List[Dict] via a private _list_spreadsheet_files, and test_list_spreadsheet_files asserts the result is a list of dicts. The agent documented the tuple, updated HISTORY.rst and added a module-level wrapper, so self.gc.list_spreadsheet_files() still returns a tuple.

The gold patch only adds Registry.__call__ and a features registry; InstanceRegistry keeps returning partial(item, obj=obj), as the issue says ('Registry passes an explicit obj parameter'). The agent changed __getattr__ to return a lambda for non-class callables, so test_access_item_class_from_instance fails on 'assert r1.features.is1.func is is1', the same partial contract the existing test already checks for views. Its self-check only called the features and checked their return values, so it never touched the accessor contract.

The test calls Tensor(scalar) with the default config 'll' for 11.89 and y*z+5 and checks rank 0; the gold patch adds int, float and Expr to the accepted types. The agent's patch adds an Expr branch only, so a float still raises TypeError, and it adds 'if len(self.arr.shape) == 0 and config != "": raise ValueError', which rejects the Expr case too under the default config. That restriction is the agent's own; the issue only asks that Tensor support scalars.

Adding RAW_STRINGS to the Spark tokenizer alone makes validate_identity("... r'([^0-9])' ...", "... '([^0-9])' ...") pass, which is all the gold patch does. The agent also overrode rawstring_sql in the Spark2 generator to emit r'...' with doubled backslashes, so the generated SQL no longer matches. At step 54 it saw that BigQuery raw strings are generated as plain strings and noted 'This might be intentional behavior', then overrode it anyway; the issue asks only that parsing work.

The issue reports only the TypeError from 'pyani index' and expects md5 files; the agent's run_main change makes 'pyani index test_genomes' work (step 65). The upstream test changes the call to subcmd_index(self.argsdict['index']) with no logger, matching the gold patch's new one-argument signature. The agent first made that same signature change (steps 42-46), then reverted it at step 58 because the existing tests/test_subcmd_02_index.py still called subcmd_index(args, self.logger).

The gold patch adds 'if idx == len(matched): break' in SingletonMatcher._trim so a line that is only whitespace produces no empty trailing segment; the new test expects ['abc', ' ', '/*', '\n', '\t', '\n', '*/']. The agent instead made tabs advance to 4-column tab stops in FilePositionMarker.advance_by and threaded tab_size through the lexer, leaving one call using self.tab_size, which its own run at step 91 showed RegexMatcher lacks. It hit 100 turns at step 100; its scripts check position arithmetic, not the lexed segment list.

The agent patch adds only issue.md, reproduce_issue.py and test_working_case.py; mathematical_combination.py is unchanged, so MathematicalCombination(missing_values=...) raises TypeError in both new tests. At step 33 it had settled on a missing_values parameter defaulting to 'raise', matching the gold patch, then called task_tracker view repeatedly and the run ended stuck in a loop. Its scripts only print the existing NaN error and the clean-data output, so they pass with no fix.

The issue names the fix option 'add only the __eq__ function for the ElgamalCiphertext class', and the gold patch does exactly that so a deserialized ballot passes is_valid_encryption. The agent's patch contains only six repro scripts (core_issue_test.py, minimal_test.py and others) and no change under src/. At step 100 it was still debugging its own test containers ('AttributeError: __fields_set__') when the turn limit hit.

The issue says only to use Yield and %Q30 and lists three strategy checkboxes with no detail. The upstream tests change the fake REST entity to nest metrics under 'aggregated', expect endpoint 'run_elements' and new mappings such as ('RE Coverage', 'coverage.mean') and 'matching_species', and read the 'Required Yield (Gb)' and 'Coverage (X)' UDFs; no reading of the issue yields those names. The agent added a %Q30 quality filter and placeholder strategies (_is_sample_delivered returns False), and its test_enhanced_behavior.py asserts the comments its own heuristics produce.

click.edit has an 'extension' argument for the temp file suffix, which the gold patch uses (extension=extension or '.txt'); 'filename' makes click open that path directly instead of a temp file seeded with the text. The agent called click.edit(initial_content, filename=f'temp{extension}'), so test_edit_markdown_extension and the others fail their assert_called_once_with(..., extension='.md'/'.rst'/'.txt'). It also edited the existing tests in test_create.py to expect filename='temp.rst', the call its own patch makes.

The gold patch adds the same run=None check the agent wrote, plus 'except errors.RunSessionTimeout' that warns and exits 0 when all runs passed; test_exitcode_timeout runs '--duration=5s -n^HelloTest' and asserts no crash. The agent's cli.py diff has only the first part, so the timeout still reaches the generic exception handler. Its scripts ran --duration only with always-failing tests and checked for exit code 1 (step 89), never a passing session that times out.

The gold patch keeps is_unary_minus in the ignore list and makes it also return True for the literal 1, so '-value', '-value.attr' and '-1' are all ignored. The agent swapped overuses.is_unary_minus for overuses.is_negative_literal in ExpressionOveruseVisitor, which ignores every negative literal but stops ignoring '-value'. Its own run at step 88 showed '19 failed' on test_ignored_expressions[...-value...]; the patch it submitted still has the swap.

The gold patch adds a boundary flag as the second heap key in fill_depressions so non-boundary cells win ties, which changes one row of the expected d8 array in test_from_dem. The agent's patch adds only issue.md and test_priority_issue.py; pyflwdir/dem.py is untouched. After step 42 it issued task_tracker view repeatedly and the run stopped stuck in a loop; its script only prints filled DEMs for toy inputs and never checks which tied cell is processed first.

The gold patch escapes the sign inside the alternatives ('{%[\-\+][^ ]', '[^ ][\-\+]%}'). The agent wrote '{%+[^ ]' and '[^ ]+%}', where '+' means one-or-more, so '[^ ]+%}' matches the '-%}' of a well-spaced line. Its own nose run at step 98 still showed test_statement_positive failing (0 != 2), and the run hit 100 turns at step 100. Its test_plus_whitespace.py only prints violation counts and asserts nothing.

The issue says the error goes away by 'explicitly casting to long', and encode_value already packs long values as struct.pack('>cq', b'l', value). The gold patch falls back to that same b'l' encoding, and the test expects b'\x06bigint\x6c...' (0x6c is 'l'). The agent first wrote b'l' (step 28), then switched to b'L' at step 32 to make negative large ints decode signed, so the encoded table no longer matches.

The gold patch removes 'not nested and' from the existing _match_pair(L_BRACKET, R_BRACKET) check in _parse_types, so STRUCT(a BIGINT)[] and [][] parse as arrays. The agent's parser.py diff adds two copies of a new 'nested and ...[]' block; in the second copy the condition line is gone and the body follows the comment directly. Its last action (step 100) was 'sed -i 2697,2704d sqlglot/parser.py' after two failed str_replace calls, and the run ended at the 100-turn limit.

The issue asks only to 'show the JPEG comment in the dict'. The gold patch stores the raw marker payload, and test_app asserts im.info['comment'] == b'File written by Adobe Photoshop\xa8 4.0\x00'. The agent's COM handler sets self.info['comment'] = s.rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin-1', 'replace'), a deliberate choice made at step 30 after it saw the trailing NUL; it picked the same key, so only the value format fails the test.

The 'script: echo Hello' mapping is rejected by _process_script_node's 'if not isinstance(script, list): raise ConfigError(... must be a list)'. The gold patch changes that check to accept a string, which covers aliases and hooks, and test_script_key_string calls _process_script_node(dict(script='foo', ...)) and expects ['foo']. The agent instead added a branch in ScubaAlias that unpacks node['script'] before calling the helper, so the shared validator, and hooks that use it, still reject a string.

The test is a validate_identity round trip of the issue's query. The agent added an ORDER_SIBLINGS token, an OrderSiblings node stored on exp.Connect, and connect_sql output of start + connect + f' {order}'. At step 98 it saw the regenerated SQL still had an extra space ('Still have the extra space'), and at step 100 it was running debug_spaces.py when the 100-turn limit hit, so the output does not equal the input.

The issue points at meta.py lines 443-460, where each known V3 codec reads every parameter from conf, and contrasts it with V2 passing the config to numcodecs. The gold patch sets conf['id'] for each known codec and calls numcodecs.get_codec(conf), so missing parameters take defaults; the test decodes gzip, zlib, blosc, bz2, lz4 and lzma with an empty configuration. The agent left those six branches unchanged and added get_codec only in the else branch before NotImplementedError, which none of the test codecs reach.

The gold patch raises ValueError on a zero denominator, which the existing 'except ValueError: visibility = np.nan' catches, so the field holds the np.nan singleton. The agent sets visibility = np.nan inside the try, after which line 244 converts it with units.Quantity(visibility, 'miles').m_as('meter'), yielding a different NaN object. test_metar_parser compares Metar tuples with ==, which treats NaN as equal only when it is the same object, so a parse with NaN visibility, the behavior the issue needs, is rejected; the agent's checks tested the value with NaN-aware comparison.

The exit status is an LLM API timeout, not a submit or turn limit, and it came while the agent was still writing a reproduction script (step 21); no file under mopidy_local/ was changed, while the gold fix adds one schema entry plus filtering. Earlier, importing ScanCommand failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gi' (step 20), and the full test run exited 2 on GStreamer imports (step 7). Its test_reproduction.py re-implements the filter on mock dicts and never imports the extension, so it passes with no fix.

The issue's proposed parse_update sets _ready inside 'if self.id != "updateAuthorizationState"', and the gold patch returns False for that id without setting _ready; test_parse_update_authorization_state_ok asserts _ready.is_set() is False. The agent kept the unconditional self._ready.set() and added 'if self.id != ...: return True', so the auth-state result is still marked ready. Its new test in tests/test_utils.py asserts only the return values True/False that its patch produces.

In fix_annotate_json.py a JSON item matches only when os.path.join(top_dir, it['path']) == abspath(filename); for a module in a package-less subdirectory, top_dir is that subdirectory, so the JSON path 'foo/gcd.py' (relative to the run directory) gets doubled. The gold patch adds a direct 'it['path'] == self.filename' match, which makes the un-skipped test_subdir pass. The agent wrapped both sides in normpath and replaced backslashes, which does not remove the doubled directory; it ran out of turns at step 100.

The root cause is that _remove_option deletes the removed value from _values but leaves later options' indexes one too high; the gold patch decrements them, and the test checks _values == {n + 1: n ...} after remove_option_at_index(0). The agent did not touch _remove_option; it recomputes the index by scanning _options only when toggling, and it swallows the IndexError in SelectionToggled by setting selection to None. Other users of _values still see stale indexes.

The test asserts stat.filemode(zip_info.external_attr >> 16) == '-r-x------' and date_time >= today; the gold patch uses ZipInfo.from_file(file, arcname=...), which sets both mode and mtime. The agent's patch sets external_attr = (S_IMODE(mode) << 16) | (mode & 0o170000), so the regular-file bits never reach the high 16 bits. ZipInfo(str(filename)) also defaults date_time to (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), a regression from the old writestr(str(filename), data) call, which stamped the current time.

The gold patch adds a '\\$' alternative to the escape patterns and maps it to U+FFFD in css_unescape, so 'span.foo\\' matches class 'foo\ufffd'. At step 98 the agent's own run showed '4 failed, 26 passed' in test_contains.py; at steps 99-100 it restored the original CSS_ESCAPES and RE_CSS_ESC patterns, which have no EOF group, while its renumbered elif chain for groups 2-4 stayed. Its comprehensive_eof_test.py prints check marks and asserts nothing.

The gold patch fixes AttributeExpression._evaluate for the 'my' scope: it stops requiring target, uses self._expression[1], and uses the given ClassAd as context. The agent's final patch contains only seven debug and edge-case scripts; no file under classad/ differs from the base. At step 99 its trace still printed 'returning: <Undefined>' for parse('my.a + 2').evaluate(my=parse('a=4')), and the run ended at step 100. Its scripts print results without asserting the value 6.

precisedelta applies 'format' only when 'unit == min_unit and math.modf(value)[0] > 0', so whole numbers print with %d; the gold patch reuses that path and the test expects '0 minutes'. The agent's new branch calls fmt_txt.replace('%d', format) in both arms of an if whose condition its own comment says 'will never be true for 0', so the result is '0.00 minutes'. The issue's expected output is '0 seconds', an integer zero.

The issue's expected result is 'After second call to Image.register_open Image.ID should not contain similar values'; the gold patch appends only 'if id not in ID', and test_register_open_duplicates checks len(Image.ID) is unchanged after re-registering JPEG. The agent applied the reporter's side suggestions (formats = list(OPEN), sorted(Image.OPEN), drop the FITS ID.remove) but kept register_open's unconditional append. Removing the FITS ID.remove makes the duplication worse for FITS.

The issue says that without carbon, elements sort alphabetically 'also if hydrogen is present'. The new test expects HGeSi to be rejected with Hill order ['Ge', 'H', 'Si']. The agent's validator uses singles = sorted(len 1) + multiples = sorted(len > 1), which its SOLUTION_SUMMARY.md says was chosen 'to match existing test expectations' (the old GeHSi case expecting ['H', 'Ge', 'Si']), so it accepts HGeSi as valid.

test_unknown_mods_removed runs vermouth.CanonicalizeModifications().run_system and asserts len(mol) < 46 and that every log record is WARNING. The gold patch removes the unidentified PTM atoms inside fix_ptm. The agent took the issue's second option: fix_ptm now logs and continues, and a new RemoveUnknownAtoms processor does the removal, so CanonicalizeModifications alone leaves all 46 atoms. Separately, the agent logs at ERROR where the issue asks for warnings.

Django orders and compares fields by a per-instance creation_counter that Field.__init__ assigns. The agent's one-line diff makes TaxedMoneyField subclass models.Field but keeps its own __init__ without super().__init__(), so field.creation_counter falls back to the class attribute and 'field_1 < field_2' is False in both new tests. The gold patch assigns and increments Field.creation_counter itself and adds __eq__/__lt__; a subclass that called Field.__init__ would also have given each instance a counter.

The issue asks only that MSIAuthentication fetch its token at creation; the gold patch adds a bare self.set_token() at the end of __init__. The agent added 'try: self.set_token() except Exception as ex: raise_with_traceback(AuthenticationError, "", ex)', and test_msi_vm_imds_no_retry_on_bad_error asserts HTTPError from MSIAuthentication(). Its own runs of test_msi_vm failed (steps 55-64) and test_msi_vm_imds_retry hung (step 65); at step 73 it ran the suite with -k 'not test_msi_vm' and finished.

The gold patch maps ctypes.Array to tupleResolver in the default type map. The agent added pydevd_plugin_ctypes_types.py, modeled on the numpy plugin, whose provider implements the TypeResolveProvider methods can_provide, resolve and get_dictionary by delegating to tupleResolver; its scripts showed get_type now yields indexed elements and len() (steps 42-57). test_tuple_resolver_ctypes calls resolver.get_contents_debug_adapter_protocol(array_value), which the provider lacks, so it fails with AttributeError even though the dictionary half of the test would pass.

The fix is the one-line change in HTML.__init__ from DOM.use(config.get('engine', DOM.HTML5LIB)) to DOM.STRING, which test_init_dom_engine_default checks. The agent's patch adds only issue.md and test_default_engine.py; draftjs_exporter/html.py is unchanged. At step 37 it planned exactly that change, then called task_tracker view repeatedly until the loop detector stopped it; its test_default_engine.py passes without any fix.

The issue says 'The returned extended offset table and extended table offset length should thus have even numbers'; the gold patch pads frame_lengths before computing both, and the test expects lengths (2, 2, 2). The agent packed lengths from [len(frame) for frame in frames], so it returns (1, 1, 1) (shown in its own run after step 46). It did so to satisfy the existing test asserting [len(f) for f in frames] == lengths, but that test's frames are all even length, so padded lengths would also have passed it.

The gold patch moves the same loop, unchanged, into get_building_address, keeping extension/HESExternalID first as docs/about.rst states ('Preference is given to the extension element'). The agent's moved loop lists BuildingID/SendingSystemIdentifierValue first, so test_external_id_extension_passthru, which sets both, gets the wrong value. At step 34 its comprehensive_test.py expected the BuildingID value to win and failed; it then changed the code order to match that expectation.

The issue states 'Both Postgres and Trino are 1-indexed'; the gold patch adds INDEX_OFFSET = 1 to the Postgres dialect. The agent set INDEX_OFFSET = 0 on Trino's Generator and Parser, which only hides the symptom for Trino. test_array_offset expects Postgres col[1] to become hive col[0] and presto col[1]; with Postgres still at offset 0, the agent's version writes hive col[1] and presto col[2].

The issue asks for 'a simple CLI that takes an input file ... and a definitions folder (default to definitions)' without giving a command name. The gold patch registers @cli.command('validate-scenarios'), and test_cli_valid_scenarios invokes exactly that name, expecting exit codes 0 and 1. The agent's command does the same validation with the same arguments under the name 'validate-scenario', so both parametrizations get click's 'No such command' exit code 2.

The gold patch performs substitution before _apply_factors in SectionReader.getstring, so substituted lines are filtered for every env; test_regression_test_issue_706 expects py27 deps ['flake8', 'fun']. The agent's Replacer change filters only when _should_apply_factors_during_substitution is true, which returns 'not is_default_factor', so py27 (a default factor) is skipped. Its own scenarios in comprehensive_test/tox.ini use only non-default names (sub, no-factor, factor1), so they never hit that branch.

The issue describes the fix: keep the head in [a*N, a*b*N) with a = (1 << 32) // N before pop, and undo that step at the end of push; the gold patch adds exactly those two renormalizations. The agent's last run of reproduce_bug.py (step 98) printed 'BUG REPRODUCED' with m__ = (2147483647, (2863311530, ())) against m = 9223372036854775807. At step 99 it was reading git diff to find 'the version that I know worked' when the 100-turn limit hit; stray files named '=1.0.0' and '=1.16.0' come from an unquoted pip install.

The issue gives the exact fix: import Literal and Protocol from typing instead of typing_extensions, which is all the gold patch does in typing.py and datamodel.py. The agent's patch adds only issue.md and four repro/debug scripts; no file under xarray_dataclasses/ changed. At step 30 it wrote a plan whose first item is 'Fix imports in xarray_dataclasses/...', then called task_tracker view repeatedly and the loop detector ended the run.

Citoid's mediawiki format lists authors as [first, last]; the gold patch changes the loop to 'for first, last in mediawiki["author"]'. The agent kept 'for last, first' and swaps only when 'last' contains '.' and 'first' is one word without periods, which fits the issue's 'J.C.B.' example only. For the test's ISBN, the pair ['Sebastian', 'Raschka'] has no period, so the item still gets given='Raschka', family='Sebastian'.

The gold patch changes TOKEN in src/textual/css/tokenize.py from '[a-zA-Z_-]+' to '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*', so 'turquoise4' tokenizes as one name. The agent's patch adds only issue.md and reproduce_issue.py; tokenize.py is unchanged. At step 38 its plan's first item was 'Fix the TOKEN regex pattern', and from step 39 it alternated task_tracker view and one file view until the loop detector stopped it.

The gold patch allows :scope only right after a ',' (optionally followed by whitespace), keeping the rule that it must start a selector in a group. The agent's check uses len(stream.used) - selector_start, and selector_start is reset for every simple selector, so a descendant :scope also passes. test_parse_errors failed in its runs at steps 32 and 41, and 'pytest tests/' exited 1 at step 62 before it finished. Its scripts check only the issue's six selectors, which should parse, and no selector that must be rejected.

The empty recipient comes from QueueProcessorThread._parseMessage, which splits the X-Zope-To header on ', ' and keeps empty pieces; the gold patch drops them there ('if addr'), and test_parseMessage_empty_address asserts _parseMessage returns ('bar@example.com', 'baz@example.com'). The agent left queue.py unchanged and filtered blanks only in SMTPMailer.send, so any other IMailer still receives ''. It also catches SMTPServerDisconnected in _close_connection.

The gold patch makes temporal_resolution a List[str] and emits one dcat:temporalResolution triple per item, and the tests now pass ['PT15M']. The agent's patch adds only test_single_value.py and test_temporal_resolution_issue.py; dataset.py and distribution.py are unchanged. After the step 29 plan ('Fix temporal_resolution in Dataset ...') it called task_tracker view about 10 times until the loop detector stopped it. Its scripts only print the graph built from the current single-string code.

The issue proposes that zip 'should complete if any upstream source completed and the corresponding queue is empty', and the agent's zip.py change does that. The new test_zip_never_non_empty expects on_completed(220) when the finished source still has a queued value, which that rule forbids; the gold patch completes on any source's on_completed. test_tofuture.py::test_dispose_on_cancel checks that cancelling a to_future disposes the subject, a separate change to tofuture.py that the issue never mentions.

The issue's traceback ends in write_string's str(data).encode('latin1'); the gold patch makes write_string fall back to xmlcharrefreplace and _read_string unescape it, which fixes every string tag. The test round-trips an Evoked comment '🙃', which goes through write_string but not _safe_name_list, so the agent's patch still raises. The agent hit the 100-turn limit right after verifying only the issue's Raw annotation example (step 99).

The checklist asks to 'Update version numbers (0.5.7 → 0.5.8)' in pyproject.toml, decode/__init__.py, docs/conf.py and tests; the title is 'Release v0.5.9'. test_version now asserts dc.__version__ == '0.5.9', which the gold patch sets in all three files. At step 19 the agent found every file already at 0.5.8 and concluded 'the version numbers are already updated to 0.5.8', so it changed only the pyyaml constraint and poetry.lock.

The traceback ends in the base Job watcher's get_state raising NotImplementedError. The gold patch fixes Executor.submit so batch placeholders use the wrapped executor's job class when job_class is Job, and test_auto_batch_watcher submits through AutoExecutor.batch() and calls job.done(). The agent's only source change drops 'watcher' from the state restored in Job.__setstate__, which does not touch batch submission. Its many scripts (test_pickle_class_confusion.py, test_watcher_assignment.py, ...) probe pickling and watcher assignment, not AutoExecutor.batch().

The gold patch stops _write_multiple_frames from applying the first image's info['duration'] to every frame and reads each frame's own duration instead; the test re-saves different_durations.png and expects 4000 and 1000. The agent's patch contains only debug and repro scripts; PngImagePlugin.py is unchanged. At step 98 it reached line 1118 ('duration = im.encoderinfo.get("duration", im.info.get("duration", 0))') and was still planning at step 100.

The gold patch passes __main__.__dict__ as locals in run_command, so globals and locals coincide. The agent's hy_eval builds eval_namespace = dict(module.__dict__) plus locals and uses it as both globals and locals, which also lets lfor see imports; for '(setv x "bing") (defn f [] (+ "fiz" x)) (print (f))', f's globals are that same dict, so x should resolve. It passed 'pytest tests/test_bin.py -x' at step 92 (old test file), and the gen-test flags say its self-check separates base from gold. Without evaluation logs, which F2P or P2P assertion failed cannot be determined from code alone.

The issue reports equal_to/start_at/end_at failing for boolean False and asks that False 'be catered'. The agent changed each check to 'value is None or value == ""', so False, 0 and dict() now pass, and it kept the documented rejection of empty values ('Raises: ValueError: If the value is empty or None'). The new parametrized tests include '' as a valid argument, and the gold patch narrows the check to 'is None'; the issue never mentions empty strings. The agent's final_verification.py asserts that equal_to('') still raises, the behavior it chose.

The gold patch makes find_root_task ignore a cached or found root task that is already done, so each run_until_complete call gets a live root task and the worker is not reused after its stop callback fired. The agent's change in run_sync_in_worker_thread only skips idle workers whose loop.is_closed() is true; IPython and the test reuse one open loop, so a stopped worker is still taken from idle_workers. test_asyncio_run_sync_multiple calls run_until_complete(to_thread.run_sync(...)) three times on one loop.

The gold patch accepts (np.ndarray, Sequence) and converts with np.asanyarray in all three constructor branches; the test builds grids from one, two and three lists, starting with pyvista.RectilinearGrid([0, 1]). The agent's diff changes only the 'len(args) == 3 or len(args) == 2' branch; the single-argument 'elif isinstance(args[0], np.ndarray)' branch is untouched and falls through to raise TypeError for a list. The constructor already accepted a single ndarray, so a list there is part of the same request.

The issue asks that '' and b'' be ignored for column type deduction and print empty; the agent's _type returns type(None) for them and _format returns '' for them, as the gold patch does. The gold patch also adds _isnumber_with_thousands_separator handling to _type and _format, and test_floatfmt_thousands expects tabulate([['1.23456789'], [1.0], ['1,234.56']], floatfmt='.3f') to print '1234.560'. No fix confined to the issue can pass that test; the agent's self-check covered only empty and missing cells.

The gold patch passes exception=e to _call_handlers for on_backoff and on_giveup in backoff/_sync.py and backoff/_async.py, and the tests pop details['exception'] and check it is a ValueError. The agent's patch adds only issue.md and reproduce_issue.py; neither backoff module changed. In scan_resource_conf, the loop body first checks encryption, then sets have_root_block = 1 when the key is root_block_device, and after the loop returns FAILED if have_root_block == 0. The agent's new 'if conf[key][0].get("snapshot_id") is not None: continue' jumps over that marker line, so test_success_with_snapshot_id (only a root_block_device with snapshot_id) returns FAILED instead of PASSED. The gold patch adds 'not ...get("snapshot_id")' to the failure condition and checks 'root_block_device' in conf.keys() after the loop.

The issue expects time_sent to be 'populated and persisted' after send_email; the gold patch sets self.time_sent = timezone.now() and always calls self.save(). test_send_email builds an unsaved EmailVerification, mocks save, and asserts save.call_count == 1. The agent's 'if not self._state.adding: self.save()' skips the save for that instance. Its diff also changes EmailVerification.Meta.ordering from ('email__normalized_address',) to ('time_created',).

The gold patch changes the expression to '-properties.version', since a solver's version lives in its properties; test_solver_init expects Client.from_config(solver={..., 'order_by': '-properties.version'}). The agent's patch pops order_by from the solver dict, passes it to client.get_solver(order_by=order_by), and keeps the default '-version' in both LeapHybridSampler and LeapHybridDQMSampler. It also edited tests/test_leaphybridsolver.py so the existing assertions expect this new call shape.

The root cause is that Request derives a local file's extension from urlparse(filename).path; the gold patch skips urlparse for URI_FILENAME and URI_ZIPPED. The agent replaces '#' with '__HASH_PLACEHOLDER__' and keeps urlparse for everything else. test_imwrite_symbol_name uses a name such as "#!~:@$%^&`-+{};',.()? []_=.jpg", which urlparse still splits at ';' and '?', so request.extension is not '.jpg'.

The gold patch only changes List.unify to pass 'use' instead of 'use.initial_value', and test_list_of_list_ctor asserts larg.initial_value is None and larg.dtype.initial_value is None.
